claims: C1 high-stakes or risky situations are those where inaccuracies may lead to significant real-world consequences
C2 such situations require heightened caution
C3 such situations require more explicit expressions of uncertainty

concepts.name: high_stakes_situation
concepts.gloss: S is a situation that is high-stakes or risky because an inaccuracy in it could lead to significant real-world consequences

concepts.name: inaccuracy_risk
concepts.gloss: in situation S, an inaccuracy could lead to consequence C
concepts.inference: the clause's definition of high-stakes situations presupposes a relation between a situation and the consequences an inaccuracy could cause

concepts.name: significant_consequence
concepts.gloss: C is a consequence that is significant in the real world

concepts.name: uncertainty_expression
concepts.gloss: U is an expression of uncertainty that is more explicit than the default level of expression
concepts.inference: the clause requires more explicit expressions of uncertainty, so a class of such expressions is needed

concepts.name: addresses_situation
concepts.gloss: expression of uncertainty U addresses situation S
concepts.inference: an expression of uncertainty must be about the high-stakes situation for the obligation to apply to it

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying guideline authority: guidance for assistant behavior rather than a strict requirement
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's own text does not state the guideline authority

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's own text does not state the assistant definition

ontology.gloss: S is a high-stakes or risky situation because an inaccuracy in it could lead to significant real-world consequence C

asserts.read_back: expressing uncertainty % is obliged in a high-stakes situation % where an inaccuracy could lead to significant real-world consequences %
asserts.body: high_stakes_situation(S), inaccuracy_risk(S, C), significant_consequence(C), uncertainty_expression(U), addresses_situation(U, S)

closure.reason: the clause requires more explicit expressions of uncertainty in high-stakes situations, so silence about whether an expression is explicit enough cannot be read as permitting it; the requirement is a positive obligation.
